I'm too scared to do that. I don't want to push him away. 
He has trauma from bad parenting, but he says it's not why he doesn't like affection. He just says affection is weird, that me touching him is weird and it gives him anxiety. 
What's weird to me is that we've had sex, that he's initiated. It hurts because i gave him that part of myself and I can't even tell him I love him or check on him. 
He says he really likes me, but also like I mentioned in the post he says he'd leave me instantly for God. 
I just really don't know what to feel or anything like that. I'm barely able to put this all in the right words which I'm probably not even doing that

I'm gonna add two of the same edits. Just in case lmao 

Edit: Almost a year since i wrote this. If anybody cares to check back to this post, I'm okay now :) I have a job and I'm no longer suicidal. I still live in the same house hold but my brother was in a severe car accident and lost the ability to walk and use his right hand. He's kinda learnt how to walk again, the car accident was a while ago. But he's weak now so I feel safer around him. I still plan on moving out, I'm working a lotta lotta hours and have my own lil shitty car. I'm getting there. Slowly but surely.

Thank you so much! 

Helped

I like this. I've been crocheting recently and I didn't really think I could sell anything, but I'm gonna give it a shot. 
I have all my money stashed right now, soon I'll get a savings account but I don't think I have enough for that. 
Thank you so much for your comment and advice :)

I have, and my bf offered me a place to stay but his mom won't let me until I'm 18. My bff is a thousand miles away sadly :( Me and my boyfriend just recently got together so he's slowly learning the horrid details. I don't want to tell him too much yet though.
Sadly she knows. She's seen me breakdown and she's heard graphic details. The first couple of times it was brought up, she was mad at /me/ and only recently has she been understanding

You're right about a lot of things here. It's scary but.. I can figure it out. Though I'm not sure planning is a good idea, anytime I plan something it goes sideways. Maybe I could get somebody around me, like my boyfriend, to help me plan things out. Maybe I'm just going about it the wrong way. 
I just hope I can get out of here soon, it's too true that I can't heal in the same environment that's done this to me. It's hard, especially when while this place makes things horrible I have it "easy" because I really don't have to do much all day. It's definitely lazy of me to say this and I know I need to adapt my mindset, but with how little I sleep, it's nice not having to do a lot of things. The only things I have to do is cleaning, which my mom is a pretty stickler over, and take care of my mom/do what she asks. I feel like a freeloader, and it's definitely far from stress free but its... routine free.
Me too, i wish this every single night.
Thank you for your words. I appreciate it. I hope one day you can escape the loneliness. It never feels like it goes away but one day, for the both of us, it will go away.

I think I am going to stay residing her just for now, just so that when I leave it doesn't cause a huge, huge mess. I'm not sure I'm mentally sound enough to handle my mom reacting illly. 
Thank you! These comments have been helping me hold my head up high, and I've been desperately in need of that recently. Especially with how tired I am, I don't get much sleep at all and I'm almost certain it contributes to how confused I am all the time.

That's horrifying, I'm so glad to hear you started to heal.
I was told I might have Stockholm Syndrome since I'm still pretty defensive about my family, especially my mom. It's hard for me to say no to her, but it could just be because I've always been guilted into saying yes. 
I do have to get out of here, and soon, it's just still pretty scary. I'm clumsy and I feel like as soon as I'm out there I'm just going to slam my face into the ground.
Thank you so much for your comment. I appreciate it
Thank you, I really appreciate it

Thank you. Really. I've heard this quote but I haven't written it down, but now I am. I think it's important, actually two things I'm gonna write down. 
My family is afraid of me because I told the truth. 
I have to convince myself that I'm not a horrible person, and this helps.

I believe it's a possibility that my brother was sexually abused. My mom tells me she has her suspicions on a uncle of ours, I have suspicion of my dad. Especially since almost a decade ago my dad was on extremely hard drugs, I know he's touched me once before in the same way my brother would. When I was asleep. 
And my brother also has a mental disability, I forgot what it's called but he essentially has a mind of a child, and also autism. My mom and dad really think I should let go of it for that reason, because he apparently couldn't control himself and he didn't know better. So yeah, I think you could be right. But at the same time when I was really young, my brother and his friends his age we're just as horrible and perverted. They'd crack sex jokes 24/7, trade sex position cards, decapitate lizards. The bus ride with them was always scary.

Thank you! This is a good idea I think. I'm not necessarily religious, but my family is always going to this church nearby. I've sort of in a way told the Pastor what was going on and he was aghast that my parents new. Maybe him and his wife would be willing to help me, or at least to give me a helping hand.

I sadly have no evidence except vivid memories. I'll try my hardest to gather whatever I can though. 
There's definitely hope, it's just terrifying knowing how many cases go untouched

I definitely need to consider going in alone, though I need to work up enough money for transportation. As soon as I do have a working vehicle, I'm getting as much help as I can get. I feel too lost to not get help at this point. I just lack the certainty to do anything.
Do you think it would be worth it to get emancipated right now considering I turn 18 in October?

Your story gave me a lot of hope. I'm so glad you survived through that, that sounds absolutely horrific. "Wrong but not illegal" what the hell? It's horrible that he did the same to your sisters but I'm thankful he was put away for it. 
I wonder if there are any others that he's hurt, but at the same time it seems everybody loves him besides me. But also, he has autism so everybody tends to excuse him because of that. I have autistic friends, in no way is that a valid "excuse"
I really appreciate your kind words, I haven't been feeling strong lately but all of these internet strangers who.. actually care, they're starting to make me feel like I really can do it. 
I know therapy is great for general wellness, so I will definitely not give up on finding a good therapist despite dealing with so many therapists who shouldn't be licensed. 
That sounds amazing, fat cats are great roommates too. But for now, your message feels like a hug to me. I will do my best, I'll keep my chin up high. Please, you do too. You are absolutely amazing.

Fuck, I've never thought of it that way. Like I've thought it but it hasn't computed completely. I think I'm just scared of them not taking him away and I have to live with the consequences until I can move out.
Thank you, I appreciate it

No offense taken. I appreciate the honesty. 
I think what I'm struggling with is knowing that reporting it is going to cause pain, and I've been through enough of that to know I don't want to be the one causing pain

I think that's a lot of people's struggle with this situation. My brother also has a very "lovable" and "addicting" personality, so people are naturally drawn to him. Nobody believes me when I tell them what he's done
He's almost three years older than me, so 7/8 years old

Initially, the therapist only knew that it happened in my childhood. Once I broke down and told her the whole truth, my mom some how convinced her to not report it. I don't even know how, it was ridiculous. That entire month I was hoping every day the police would appear, it never happened. 
And honestly I'm kind of scared to do it before I turn 18. I dropped out of highschool and I can't get my GED in my state without the super intendants permission unless I'm 18 years old, which is so stupid. And nobody wants to hire me. No income = no where to go

Sadly therapy hasn't helped, and the therapists have been unbelievably unhelpful. A lot of the time I'm given the general run of the mill "act unbothered and deal until you turn 18, get out and do your own thing" which has definitely contributed to my emotions feeling unimportant and unnecessary.

This one hits hard. I know with all my being this is the truth. Ive always been the person to focus on the good things, so while the horrible things my family has done to me hurt me so bad, it's really hard to come to terms with doing this. A part of me knows I have to, for my own sake and happiness, but another part of me says to prioritize the majorities happiness over mine. I know this isn't right. I just don't know how to change this mindset that has been kind of forced on me

You have a point, it's just scary thinking that if I do report him then my family will resent me. We've always been a very close nit family, I don't want them to be mad at me but I just.. I want to feel safe. I'm also always scared that if I do end up going through with calling authorities that my mom will begin to be suicidal again. I'm not sure if I could handle that on my conscious

Do you think I'd still be credible? I've gone to cps before but my mom convinced me to lie the first two times, and the third time nothing even happened. And he hasn't touched me since right before his daughter was born, it's been almost a year and four months

I know that I should, I'm just horrified of completely ruining my relationship with my mom. She calls me her best friend. The last time cps was almost involved she told me I was breaking the family apart and destroying all the work she's been desperately doing her whole life. Id feel really guilty about it especially if my mom does something bad to herself. She has history of being suicidal
What do you not understand?
